title: The Whisperer of Gold in the Wilderness
intro: Picture a vast desert encampment in a moment of waiting and uncertainty. A great leader has gone away for a meeting with the Divine, leaving behind a community eager for something tangible to hold onto. In that restless pause, a persuasive figure steps forward with shining promises and a clever creation that seems alive.
clues: I was among those who left Egypt with Musa, witnessing the sea parted for our escape.
I watched when our leader went to the mountain for forty nights to receive guidance.
I gathered ornaments from the people and shaped them with my own hands.
I fashioned a calf that gave a lowing sound, and I called the people to it.
I took a handful of dust from the track of the messenger and cast it into what I made.
I was confronted by Musa and condemned to say 'touch me not' and live apart, with a meeting promised for judgment.

options: As-Samiri
Abu Lahab
Namrud
Haman
Qarun

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Demanded worship as the highest lord in Egypt
Built an ark to survive the great flood
Ordered a great fire to burn Ibrahim
Fashioned a golden calf that misled the Israelites
Plotted to kill Muhammad at the migration
trial.answer: Fashioned a golden calf that misled the Israelites

location.label: Key Element
options: The stone tablets of the Torah
A handful of dust from the messenger's track
The cool fire prepared for Ibrahim
The mighty throne brought in a blink
The wooden ark built of planks and nails
location.answer: A handful of dust from the messenger's track

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Swallowed by the earth with treasures
Destroyed by a mighty blast from the sky
Turned into apes for breaking the Sabbath
Drowned in the sea with pursuing army
Condemned to say 'touch me not' in isolation awaiting judgment
outcome.answer: Condemned to say 'touch me not' in isolation awaiting judgment

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
